_comment: R319 §E-10 leak allowlist — written reasons REQUIRED (the R318 collision-allowlist discipline). An innerText line matching a leak pattern is excused when it CONTAINS one of these phrases. Raw r\d{2,3} codes are NEVER allowlisted — they must not ship.
